record: Spire Codex public run export for v0.107.1
_comment: Event option pages: the human run record's option names (Spire Codex public run export for v0.107.1) to the copy's option index. Built by scripts/build_event_option_titles.py from the live captures in tests/fixtures/events, the engine's event code and the record's own keys and outcomes (aggregates; counts under 20 are not shown). mapping: exact = the name's words are in a captured title of that page; inferred = engine order or outcomes, evidence in the row; unresolved = no index (dynamic = the index depends on the options the visit offered).
